overviewHtml:
Teams running deployments with ArgoCD lack a view of sync activity and application states. This project integrates ArgoCD with Dynatrace so you can see sync history and deployment health in one place.

What you get

  • Dashboards for ArgoCD application lifecycle and platform observability
  • OpenPipeline ingest source and pipeline for normalized SDLC events
  • Insight to optimize your ArgoCD deployments
prereqsHtml: • Install Dynatrace Configuration as Code via Monaco
setupHtml:
1. Create a Platform token with the following permissions.
  • Run apps: app-engine:apps:run
  • View OpenPipeline configurations: settings:objects:read
  • Edit OpenPipeline configurations: settings:objects:write
  • Create and edit documents: document:documents:write
  • View documents: document:documents:read
  1. Store the retrieved platform token in an environment variable.

Windows:

    $env:DYNATRACE_PLATFORM_TOKEN='<YOUR_PLATFORM_TOKEN>'

Linux / macOS:

    export DYNATRACE_PLATFORM_TOKEN='<YOUR_PLATFORM_TOKEN>'
  1. Clone the Dynatrace configuration as code sample repository and go to argocd_observability.
    git clone https://github.com/Dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code-samples.git
    cd dynatrace-configuration-as-code-samples/argocd_observability
  1. Edit the manifest.yaml by exchanging the `` placeholder with your Dynatrace environment ID.
    manifestVersion: 1.0
    projects:
      - name: pipeline_observability
    environmentGroups:
      - name: group
        environments:
          - name: <YOUR-DT-ENV-ID>
            url:
              type: value
              value: https://<YOUR-DT-ENV-ID>.apps.dynatrace.com
            auth:
              platformToken:
                name: DYNATRACE_PLATFORM_TOKEN
getStartedHtml:
You need Monaco and a Dynatrace platform token.

  1. Create a platform token and store it in an environment variable
  2. Enter your environment ID in the manifest
  3. Deploy the project with Monaco

Full setup instructions are in the README.
